decisions.reason: The new delivery window and conditional cancellation consequence do not change the required creative concept or reference strategy.
The deadline decision does not alter any required product keywords, claims, prohibited terms, or messaging sources.
The demand for delivery within 24 hours and pristine overall quality does not resolve or modify the specific audio-level requirement or its existing ambiguity.
The source changes the delivery deadline and cancellation consequence but does not alter the conversion objective, CPL target, or performance priority.
The initial video remains the required deliverable; imposing a deadline and threatening future cancellation does not change its count, duration, commissioning stage, or conditional follow-up order.
The source does not change or revoke the already completed preview-and-review workflow and instead concerns delivery of the outstanding video.
The general demand for pristine video quality does not necessarily resolve the production-method ambiguity or modify the existing realism, actual-footage, avatar, or static-image constraints.
